findings.redBefore: All configured WorkOnce invariants accepted CreateChild without pendingNext and, independently, ManualRetry and Rerun retaining prior-generation childCreated.

findings.redBefore: Changing outbox MaxPasses from 4 to 2 left the entire non-runtime formal shard green: synthetic unsafe transitions escaped the legal poststate bound and falsely certified third-pass coverage.

MaxPasses=2 now fails for missing third-pass witness; removal of domain filtering fails the exact sentinel.
